lines.text: # C01 B1 — Production Job Memory Limit / Diagnostic Execution Design (Internal)

Read-only design review. No model load, prediction, Windows configuration change, or code modification performed. **B1: NO-GO to B2 under the previously agreed STOP-at-B1 rule.** The engineering integration is possible, but there is no evidence-qualified operating window in which a job-wide cap both preserves robust OS commit headroom and allows progress into the model stage whose memory allocation caused the previous stops. This is a decision about proceeding with this PC and current evidence, not proof that no theoretical limit exists.

**NO-GO to B2 at this time.** The design issues are fixable in principle but the available evidence does not justify meaningful and safe post-checkpoint diagnostic reachability in the current 16 GiB machine. The STOP rule was agreed in advance. Retain S1–S4 and both failed runs. Do not execute more inference or publish a Technical Record automatically; MSC/minimum-claim and output venue are separate later Work decisions.
